body:
Part B of issue 691 (https://github.com/IronbellyOrg/IronClaude/issues/691). Part A (PR 693) made the claim save its launch result as `.dev/issues/<N>/launch-result.json`. This change makes the issue 442 observation scripts read it: `session-gov.sh` and the observation runbook take the terminal, the layers and the release instruction from that file only, with no screen parsing and no `orca terminal list` lookup. A result file older than the claim's start counts as missing (the script records the start just before it types the claim, and checks the file's modification time and the `launched_at` field). A missing or old file stops with `PENDING`, a broken file with `FAIL`. Also fixed: `run_c` set `MAIN` after the function that needs it.

## Files changed

- `.dev/issues/442/scripts/session-gov.sh`
- `.dev/issues/442/scripts/session-gov-selftest.sh`
- `.dev/issues/442/scripts/runbook-selftest.sh`
- `.dev/issues/442/observation-runbook.md`
- the plan and ledger under `.dev/tasks/done/TASK-WF-planIssue691Part-20261120-204103/`

## Tests

- `bash .dev/issues/442/scripts/selftest.sh` ends `SELFTEST_OK` (451 OK, 0 FAIL).
- session-gov selftest: 135 OK. Runbook selftest: 22 OK.
- The new tests fail against the old script (78 FAIL).
- `bash -n`, `make verify-sync` and `make lint` exit 0.

## Plan

`.dev/tasks/done/TASK-WF-planIssue691Part-20261120-204103/`

Refs #691. This does not close issue 691: a live claim leaving the file in the main checkout is not yet shown.

## Not done, waits for the owner's yes in chat

- `superclaude install`, then a live OB-H2 rerun on the disposable issues to confirm a real claim leaves the file.

## UNVERIFIED

- `shellcheck` was not run here (no binary; CI runs it).
- The same-second staleness edge (a result written by an earlier claim in the very second this claim starts would be accepted).

Not to be merged until the owner says so.
